Senses.Explanation: The branch that never sprouts, on which Chan verse sets the real flowering: jade flowers, pure fragrance, the ordination light, the green shade of the one sentence. Baiyu Jingsi, at the master-requested address, raises the whisk: no bias, no host, the temple pole free to be kicked down — leaves and flowers join on the unsprouting branch, phoenix and luan dance in the shadowless grove, no merit involved, great ease obtained; Yingning Zhijing, offering the first incense of his new seat, roots it in the great earth, fragrance from before that shore, blooming on the unsprouting branch, plucked in a flash to offer to founding teacher Sakya; and Pinjixiang Zhixiang, at spring's first stirring, watches all flowers contend in the open sun on the unsprouting branch and strange birds wake from the first eon in the shadowless grove. Yuan'an Liao, asked how to repay his dead mother, answers in one couplet — the gold phoenix dances on the shadowless tree, the jade flower opens on the unsprouting branch; Miyin Zhenchuan, on the day the long rain breaks, verses that on the unsprouting branch the cold wind folds and through the shadowless grove the sagely color fills; Meixi Fudu, conferring the precepts, tethers the wild horse in the shadowless grove and locks the mad monkey on the unsprouting branch; Hansong Zhicao, at a tonsure, sends red flame flying in the shadowless grove and the pure fragrance broadcasting on the unsprouting branch; and Liao'an Qingyu draws the line in the small assembly — with one sentence reaching you, green shade layers on the unsprouting branch; without it, five petals open on the shadowless tree.
